claims.text: Reliance BP Mobility Limited (RBML), operating under the Jio-bp brand, expanded its network to 2,221 outlets in Q1 FY2026-27, up from 1,991 in Q1 FY2026-27.
RBML’s Motor Spirit (MS) volumes grew 16.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27, reflecting continued market-share momentum.
RBML’s High-Speed Diesel (HSD) volumes decreased by 1.9% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
RBML’s CBG (Compressed Bio-Gas) volumes increased 161% year-on-year and CNG volumes increased 13% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
Jio-bp Pulse achieved a monthly footfall of over 50,000 customers in Q1 FY2026-27, supported by an expanding fast-charging network of 5,820 live charging points.
Reliance Retail’s Grocery Digital Commerce average daily orders increased 116% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
Digital channel share contributed 13.4% of Grocery B2C revenue in Q1 FY2026-27, up 160 basis points year-on-year.
Reliance Retail’s active seller base grew 26% year-on-year in Q1 FY2026-27.
Reliance Industries maximized product netback in Q1 FY2026-27 by placing products in deficit markets such as Singapore, Australia, and East & South Africa.
Jio-bp navigated the Middle East crisis in Q1 FY2026-27, ensuring fuel availability and safeguarding national fuel supply despite industry-wide margin compression.
Reliance Retail launched targeted campaigns such as 'Bachat ki Baarish', 'Super Saver Summer', and 'Home Utsav' to drive demand in Q1 FY2026-27.
JioMart serviced approximately 5,500 pin codes and connected over 2,500 Digital and Fashion & Lifestyle stores to two-hour delivery in Q1 FY2026-27.
